items.question: What sign identifies the manner or retinue as requiring renovation?
premises: The manner or the retinue are presented as alternatives.
Their being worn out serves as an identifying condition.
This worn-out state constitutes the relevant characteristic.
items.inference: When the manner or retinue is worn out, that condition marks it as requiring renovation.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of the fused token tu sa lakṣaṇam in this fragment is partly unclear.
items.plain_english: Whether it is the manner or the retinue, if they are worn out, that is the sign.
